understanding: Verify IIR reports highest pending interrupt per documented 011/010/110/001/000 priority with source and reset actions and that IIR reads always show bits 7:6 as 11 and 5:4 as 00, building on IER enable-pending base.
preconditions: dep_t_ier_iir_pend_done: IER enable programming and IIR bit0 pending correlation available [f_ier0,f_ier1,f_ier2,f_ier3,f_pending]
reset_entry_observed: FIFOs cleared and all interrupts disabled before enable programming [f_all_disabled]

ownership: wishbone_slave_interface drives IIR IER LSR MSR RBR THR accesses via symbolic addresses with IIR physical 2 documented [f_iir_addr]; uart_serial_data drives srx_pad_i and observes stx_pad_o; modem_control_if drives CTS DSR RI DCD toggles; interrupt_output passively observes int_o
clock_reset_common: clock period fixed per test and reset driven via common reset; polarity duration and deassert-to-first-write pending q_reset
stimulus_steps: WAIT reset deassertion plus bounded drain; SAMPLE IIR reset value C1h [f_iir_reset] with fixed bits [f_fixed54,f_fixed76]
FOR each IER enable combination under test DO program enables via wishbone writes [f_ier0,f_ier1,f_ier2,f_ier3]

FOR each single source in RLS RDA Timeout THRE Modem DO generate condition in assigned context: error_recovery for RLS [f_rls] normal_traffic with symbolic trigger level for RDA [f_rda] Timeout [f_timeout] THRE [f_thre] modem handshake toggle for Modem [f_modem]; SAMPLE IIR read completion [f_highest,f_iir_addr]

FOR multi-source priority DO assert higher plus lower pending together; SAMPLE IIR and expect highest per 1st RLS over 2nd RDA Timeout over 3rd THRE over 4th Modem [f_rls,f_rda,f_timeout,f_thre,f_modem,f_highest]

APPLY documented reset control per observed code: read LSR for 011 [f_rls] drain FIFO below trigger for 010 [f_rda] read RBR for 110 [f_timeout] write THR or read IIR for 001 [f_thre] read MSR for 000 [f_modem]; WAIT bounded drain then re-SAMPLE IIR to confirm clear
REPEAT IIR reads across init and all traffic sequences to exercise fixed-bits invariant [f_fixed54,f_fixed76]
check_steps: COMPARE IIR bit0 0 pending versus 1 none [f_pending] against IER enables [f_ier0,f_ier1,f_ier2,f_ier3] in top-level scoreboard

COMPARE IIR bits 3:1 against highest pending code per table 011 RLS 1st [f_rls] 010 RDA 2nd [f_rda] 110 Timeout 2nd [f_timeout] 001 THRE 3rd [f_thre] 000 Modem 4th [f_modem] with highest-pending linkage [f_highest]
COMPARE IIR bits 7:6==11 [f_fixed76] and 5:4==00 [f_fixed54] on every IIR read including reset C1h [f_iir_reset]; fail on mismatch as ast_IIR_fixed_bits
COMPARE int_o events from interrupt_output monitor against enabled pending expectation; fail on spurious missing or mis-prioritized
coverage_steps: SAMPLE cg_iir_interrupt cp_iir_pending pending_0 versus no_pending_1 on each IIR read completion via wishbone monitor analysis port [f_pending]
SAMPLE cp_iir_code code_011_rls code_010_rda code_110_timeout code_001_thre code_000_modem and illegal 100_101_111 on each IIR read [f_rls,f_rda,f_timeout,f_thre,f_modem]
SAMPLE cp_iir_fixed fixed_76_11 fixed_54_00 and illegal any_other on each IIR read; antecedent never triggered is failure [f_fixed54,f_fixed76]
completion: Done when reset C1h fixed-bits read plus single-source checks for all five codes and at least one multi-source highest-priority resolution with documented clear action each show scoreboard comparison
Bound by TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES plus drain_cycles flush as TESTBENCH operational limits not DUT timing; stages in order sequences within stage concurrent
Basic single-source functional test first then priority and fixed-bits invariant tests; each test observes at least one scoreboard comparison

facts.statement: IIR bit0 0 means interrupt pending and 1 means no interrupt pending
facts.quote:
Bit 0 indicates that an interrupt is pending when it’s logic ‘0’. When it’s ‘1’ – no interrupt
is pending.

facts.statement: IIR reports current highest priority pending interrupt
facts.quote:
The IIR enables the programmer to retrieve what is the current highest priority pending
interrupt.

questions: q_int_o_polarity: What is documented INT_O asserted versus negated level for correlating IIR bit0 0 pending versus 1 none?
q_reset_binding: What is wb_rst_i active polarity required reset duration in CLK cycles and deassert-to-first-write delay for IIR reset C1h and fixed-bits assertion disable?
q_bus_addr: What is explicit wb_adr_i pin value for IIR reads at documented address 2 and for IER LSR MSR RBR THR accesses DLAB gating and addr 7 handling for 8-bit FIFO-only use?
q_bus_drive: What are required wb_sel_i values owners tie-offs and inactive levels of wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i for 8-bit register reads and writes?
q_rls_stimulus: What documented programming creates parity overrun framing or break for deterministic RLS 011 stimulus without inventing serial settings?
q_timeout_measure: How is 4 Char times defined in clock baud divisor terms for deterministic Timeout 110 stimulus and clear by RBR read?
q_second_priority_tie: When RDA 010 and Timeout 110 both 2nd priority are simultaneously pending which code must IIR report as highest?
q_clear_observation: On which CLK edge after documented reset action must updated IIR be observable and does reading IIR to clear THRE perturb other pending codes?
